scripts.dev:backend: npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate && npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev
scripts.crawl:import: npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate && node apps/api/scripts/import-crawl-dataset.js
scripts.crawl:dataset: npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate && node apps/api/scripts/run-crawl-dataset.js
scripts.crawl:scheduled: npm --prefix apps/api run prisma:generate && node apps/api/scripts/run-scheduled-crawl.js
scripts.setup: npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy
